name.description: The name of the user providing the feedback.

message.description: The feedback or suggestion provided by the user.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the feedback was submitted.

poiId.description: The ID of the Point of Interest the feedback is about, if applicable.

SurveyResponse.title: Survey Response
SurveyResponse.description: Represents a user's survey response for a Point of Interest.

poiId.description: The ID of the Point of Interest being surveyed.

poiName.description: The name of the Point of Interest.

guidance.description: Did the user receive guidance service? (true for Yes, false for No)

staffing.description: Was there a staff member who attended to the user? (true for Yes, false for No)

cleanliness.description: User rating for cleanliness, from 1 to 5.

transportation.description: User rating for ease of transportation, from 1 to 5.

userId.description: The anonymous user ID of the respondent.

Content.title: Content
Content.description: Represents a piece of dynamic content for QR codes.

slug.description: The URL-friendly identifier for the content, derived from the title.

body.description: The main body of the content, can be long text or markdown.

imageUrl.description: URL of an optional image for the content.

VisitorCount.title: Visitor Count
VisitorCount.description: Stores the total number of unique visitors.

count.description: The total count of unique visitors.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Stores user feedback and suggestions. Publicly readable and writable.

/surveys/{surveyId}.description: Stores survey responses for POIs. Publicly writable, but only readable by admins.

/content/{contentSlug}.description: Stores dynamic content for QR codes, identified by a URL-friendly slug. Publicly readable, admin-only writable.

/visitors/counter.description: A single document to store the unique visitor count. Publicly readable and writable for increments.
